sections.heading: Warp Divergence
sections.gist: When threads within the same warp take different branch paths, the GPU must execute each path serially — all threads execute all paths, but only threads that satisfy the condition commit their results.

sections.heading: Occupancy Optimization

sections.heading: Concurrent Kernel Execution
sections.gist: Multiple kernels can execute concurrently through different streams (command queues), suitable for scenarios where a single kernel cannot fully utilize the GPU.
